panel.intro: The operations here pull answers straight from this data without AI, each with its source. The same question always returns the same answer, and Ask uses them automatically.
panel.emptyList: There are no operations for this kind of data yet. You can ask anything in Ask.
panel.errHead: The list of operations could not be loaded.

author.subhead: Draft with AI (build one from what you want)
author.hint: Describe what you want and the AI drafts a read-only search (SPARQL) grounded in this data's words. The draft is editable in place, and nothing is final until you save it.
author.intentPlaceholder: e.g. given a composition, return the crystal structure (space group, crystal system)
author.proposeErrHead: The draft could not be created.
author.dirtyConfirm: You have unsaved edits in the draft. Discard them and continue?

notice.saved: Saved "{{name}}". Ask can use it now.

save.required: Enter a title and the query.

panel.deleteConfirm:
Delete "{{name}}"?
It will be removed from this dataset's Ask.

card.sparqlSummary: Technical details: the query this tool runs

gate.ok: ✓ AI draft: validation OK (you can save as-is)
gate.bad: Needs fixing: {{error}} (edit and fix, then save)
gate.note: The server validates on save (read-only SELECT/ASK, safe binding).

draft.title: Review and edit the draft
draft.nameHint: Derived from the title. It cannot be changed after saving — Ask calls the tool by this identifier.

result.head: Output mapping (optional, column name → SPARQL variable)
result.empty: If unspecified, the variable name is used as the column name.

runner.hint: Pulls the answer straight from this data, without AI (with sources).
runner.cellCopyTip: · Click a cell to copy it.
runner.cellCopyTitle: Click to copy the full value
runner.citeErrHead: The citation could not be built.
runner.errBody: Check the values you entered and try again.

result.sparqlSummary: Technical details: the query that ran

search_text.title: Search the full text of documents
search_text.description: Search the sentences of the documents you took in. Any hit can be cited as it stands.

quote_with_citation.title: Quote a sentence with its source
quote_with_citation.description: Take one sentence out together with its source — the document, the section, and the record of how it was read.

node.label: Sentence ID
node.placeholder: the ID copied from a full-text search result

fetch_passage.title: Read a whole section
fetch_passage.description: Pick a section of a document and read its paragraphs together. Every paragraph stays citable.

paper.label: Document
paper.placeholder: the document ID, or a PMCID (e.g. PMC5951533)

measurement_provenance.title: Link a measured value to its figure and its stated condition
measurement_provenance.description: For a value read off a figure, return the figure it came from and the sentence that states how it was measured.
